notes.title: Game is released!
notes.notes:
Interballistic Symphony is now out! You can now purchase it and prove to the world you have what it takes to become an interballsitic master!

There are three modes you can play. Normal, marathon mode and endless mode.
Endless mode have highscore lists. You think you have what it takes to be a top baller? 

Want to know more about interballistic or my other projects? Check out our discord [url=https://discord.gg/veB6fjPycS]server[/url]
